products.title: MOSS Jacket
products.body_html:
Break free from ordinary with the Xavia Moss Jacket — where performance-driven design meets modern riding style. More than just a jacket, Moss is an all-season companion crafted for riders who expect technical function, versatile protection, and casual confidence on and off the bike.

Built from advanced soft-shell polyester blended with elastane, the Moss Jacket delivers a refined balance of flexibility, abrasion resistance, and everyday comfort. The fabric moves naturally with your body, ensuring a relaxed yet secure fit — whether you're carving through city traffic or taking on weekend rides.

Protection is built in, not added on. CE Level 2 certified armor at the elbows, shoulders, and back forms the backbone of its safety structure, with additional layered reinforcement and discreet padding in key impact zones. This combination offers robust protection while preserving freedom of movement and a clean silhouette.

Temperature regulation is seamless thanks to Air Burst mesh paneling integrated into the main front zipper area, chest, biceps, and back — allowing air to circulate where it’s needed most. Whether you're riding in warm conditions or working through transitional weather, Moss adapts with you. A removable hoodie adds extra versatility and everyday wearability.

The Moss Jacket doesn’t just perform — it delivers on the details. Waterproofing keeps light rain at bay without sacrificing breathability, and a system of internal and external storage pockets ensures you have space for your essentials. Designed to keep you comfortable, protected, and organized, this is a jacket that works as hard as you ride.

For those who move between city streets and open roads with equal ease, the Xavia Moss Jacket offers a perfect fusion of protection, performance, and progressive styling — made for the ride and everything that comes with it.

products.title: AIREON Pant
products.body_html:
The Aireon Pant from Xavia Racing is not just another motorcycle jacket – it’s a game-changer. Designed for the rider who demands both ultimate protection and everyday comfort, this jacket seamlessly adapts to your ride, whatever the conditions.  

Versatility Meets Innovation: At its core, the Aireon offers a 3-in-1 solution. Its breathable mesh shell keeps you cool in warm weather, while the removable waterproof and thermal linings ensure that you're always prepared, whether it's a sudden downpour or a chilly evening ride. No matter the season, the Aireon Jacket has you covered.  

Protection That’s Second to None: Safety is never compromised. With CE certified protectors at the shoulders, elbows, and back, this jacket offers premium protection against impact, so you can focus on the road ahead with confidence.  

Visibility When It Matters: Reflective stripes placed on the lower chest, arms, and back boost your visibility during low-light conditions, keeping you safe and seen – day or night.  

We know that comfort and fit matter just as much as protection. That’s why the Aireon Jacket comes equipped with adjustment tabs at the biceps, collar, waist, and cuffs, allowing you to dial in the perfect fit for your ride. Whether you’re carving through twisty roads or cruising the highways, this jacket stays in place, offering unparalleled comfort.  

The Aireon doesn’t just perform – it looks the part too.  

With two exterior pockets and multiple interior compartments, you’ll have plenty of space for your essentials, all while keeping a sleek profile.  

The Aireon Jacket is built to keep you safe, dry, and comfortable – wherever your ride takes you. Whether you're a weekend warrior or a daily commuter, this jacket is your new go-to for style, protection, and performance.

products.title: AIRMESH Jacket
products.body_html:
The Airmesh Jacket from Xavia Racing sets a new benchmark for summer riding gear, offering advanced protection in a featherlight package. Designed for riders who refuse to compromise between comfort, performance, and safety, this jacket is built to thrive in high temperatures and unpredictable conditions. With its high-strength mesh construction and strategic airflow zones across the chest, back, and arms, it promotes constant ventilation to help regulate body temperature — even during long rides under a blazing sun.

Though lightweight, the Airmesh takes protection seriously. It comes equipped with CE Level 2 certified protectors on the shoulders, elbows, and back — all fully removable and adjustable to suit your riding posture. These armor elements offer premium impact resistance without bulk, so you stay agile and focused on the road ahead. And when the weather takes a sudden turn, the integrated waterproof liner offers reliable coverage against unexpected showers, all while preserving the jacket’s breathability and minimal weight.

Designed with precision, the Airmesh features a clean, anatomical silhouette that follows the contours of the body without restricting movement. The tailored fit improves aerodynamics while riding and enhances comfort during longer journeys. Reflective piping across the front, back, and sleeves creates a 360° visibility effect that improves your presence on the road when light conditions begin to fade — a critical safety advantage during early morning commutes or evening returns.

Comfort and customization go hand in hand. The Airmesh includes a finely-tuned adjustment system to achieve your ideal fit: micrometric Velcro closures at the waist and cuffs, adjustable snap buttons at the biceps, and soft ergonomic tabs that let you dial in tension without discomfort. These thoughtful details ensure the jacket adapts naturally to your body, whether you’re leaning into a curve or navigating city traffic.

Resistant to UV rays and everyday wear from the elements, the Airmesh is made to perform over time — keeping its structure, looks, and technical features intact ride after ride. For riders who demand lightweight performance, high-end protection, and sleek urban styling, the Xavia Airmesh Jacket is the ultimate warm-weather companion, built for summer freedom and everyday reliability.

products.title: VENTRA Jacket
products.body_html:
The Xavia Ventra Jacket is built for long-distance riders who demand versatile protection, reliable comfort, and dependable performance across changing conditions. Engineered with precision, it offers a refined touring experience through all seasons, without compromising on safety or practicality.

Designed as a true 3-layer system, the Ventra features a waterproof outer shell, a removable thermal liner, and a removable waterproof membrane — giving you full control over insulation and breathability depending on the weather. The main outer layer is inherently waterproof, providing immediate protection from rain and wind without the need for additional gear.

CE-certified Level 2 protectors are integrated at the shoulders, elbows, and back, delivering premium impact protection while maintaining flexibility and comfort for long days in the saddle. The jacket also includes trouser connectors for added lower-body security — an essential feature for extended touring or higher-speed riding.

Ventilation is engineered for maximum effectiveness. Zippered intake vents on the chest, arms, and back promote consistent airflow, while a discreet front zip extension reveals an additional ventilation panel along the main closure. This intelligent airflow system ensures that heat and moisture are efficiently managed, even in warmer climates or during intensive riding.

Functionality is at the forefront of the Ventra’s design. Waterproof external pockets offer secure storage for essentials, while ergonomic shaping and adjustable fit points at the biceps, waist, and cuffs ensure personalized comfort. Reinforced stitching and durable YKK zippers round out a construction that’s built to last.

Whether you're navigating mountain passes, cruising highways, or riding through unpredictable weather, the Xavia Ventra Jacket is your ideal companion. With a focus on adaptability, rider-focused features, and sleek touring aesthetics, it delivers performance you can trust — mile after mile.

products.title: REGAL Jacket
products.body_html:
The Xavia Regal Jacket is engineered for riders who demand uncompromising protection, refined functionality, and all-weather versatility — without sacrificing style. Designed with precision and purpose, it combines advanced safety features with technical performance to meet the highest expectations on and off the road.

 

At the core of its protective design is a complete set of CE Level 2 certified protectors at the shoulders, elbows, and back, delivering superior impact resistance in line with professional standards. Reinforced yet unobtrusive, these protectors allow for confident, focused riding across varied conditions and environments.

 

The Regal’s adaptability makes it a true all-season companion. A fully waterproof outer shell shields against rain without the need for additional covers, while removable inner layers — a thermal liner and a waterproof membrane — allow for precise climate control. In warmer conditions, a front zip extension reveals a hidden ventilation panel, complemented by strategically placed vents on the chest, arms, and back for optimized airflow and sustained comfort during long rides.

 

Built for functionality as much as form, the Regal Jacket features waterproof external pockets to safeguard essentials, along with robust YKK zippers for long-lasting performance. A tailored cut, ergonomic design, and integration points for connection to riding trousers enhance both comfort and protection, adapting seamlessly to a rider’s posture and movement.

 

Combining high-end materials, intelligent ventilation, and a sleek, structured silhouette, the Xavia Regal Jacket delivers exceptional performance for discerning riders. Whether navigating urban routes or touring across variable terrain, it ensures you remain protected, comfortable, and ready for whatever the journey brings.

products.title: MISANO Jacket
products.body_html:
The Misano Jacket from Xavia Racing blends vintage character with modern protection in a piece that’s built to ride. Crafted from high-quality soft cowhide leather, this jacket is a tribute to classic motorcycling heritage — but under its timeless styling lies a serious technical structure. Designed for riders who want old-school looks without sacrificing modern safety, the Misano is equipped with CE Level 2 certified protectors on the back, shoulders, and elbows. Reinforced multilayer leather with vertical stitching enhances impact zones, adding structural integrity exactly where it matters most.

Comfort meets craftsmanship in every detail. Ventilated leather panels are seamlessly integrated across the jacket to ensure airflow during warmer rides, maintaining a comfortable internal temperature without disrupting the jacket’s elegant lines. Inside, a fixed mesh lining adds breathability, while a removable thermal liner allows the Misano to shift easily between seasons — giving you the flexibility to ride through both summer heat and cooler conditions with confidence.

Functionality is built into the fit. Elastic leather inserts are placed strategically to encourage natural arm movement and reduce resistance, especially in an aggressive riding posture. The collar is lined with an exceptionally soft-touch material, adding comfort in high-contact areas, while adjustable waist straps and a customizable collar closure allow for a tailored silhouette without compromising mobility.

Storage is minimal and purposeful. Two exterior pockets at the front offer easy access to essentials, supported by multiple interior compartments that keep your valuables organized and secure. Vintage-style YKK zippers reinforce the jacket’s timeless character, while a connection loop and traditional zipper provide integration with compatible riding trousers — making the Misano a complete and road-ready piece.

With its balanced fusion of heritage styling, protective features, and thoughtful ergonomic design, the Misano Leather Jacket is a standout piece for riders who value authenticity without giving up performance. Whether you’re commuting through the city or carving weekend backroads, it brings classic confidence to every ride.

products.title: GALE jacket
products.body_html:

Additional padding on the abdomen and lower back adds another layer of safety where it's most needed, providing peace of mind in challenging conditions. Built for durability, flexibility, and uncompromising protection, the Gale Jacket is the dependable companion for riders who move between terrains, seasons, and challenges with confidence. Wherever your journey takes you, this jacket is made to go the distance.

products.body_html:
The Gale Jacket from Xavia Racing redefines what it means to ride in complete confidence. Designed for those who demand more from their gear, this jacket delivers an exceptional balance of protection, comfort, and adaptability. Built with a rugged waterproof outer shell and reinforced with critical safety features, it’s engineered to handle the demands of serious riders — no matter the distance or destination.

Equipped with CE Level 2 certified protectors at the shoulders, elbows, and back, the Gale ensures advanced impact protection across all key areas. Additional padding on the abdomen and lower back adds another layer of safety where it's most needed, providing peace of mind in challenging conditions. Whether you’re riding through dense traffic or pushing through a winding mountain route, the Gale is prepared to shield you from the unexpected.

Breathability is carefully considered through strategically positioned ventilation zippers at the chest and back. These vents allow you to control airflow as conditions change, offering comfort on long rides without sacrificing the jacket’s weather-resistant capabilities. Stretch panels beneath the arms and at the elbows offer freedom of movement and flexibility where it counts, making this jacket as responsive as it is protective.

Riding visibility is elevated with reflective panels subtly integrated throughout the jacket’s exterior, increasing your presence during night rides or in poor weather. These high-visibility elements are designed to catch light from every angle, giving you added safety without disrupting the jacket’s sleek, technical profile.

Every rider is different, and the Gale adapts accordingly. Adjustment tabs at the biceps, plus Velcro closures at the waist, cuffs, and adjustable collar, allow for a fully customizable fit that stays in place — whether you’re leaning into tight corners or cruising through city streets. Every detail is engineered to support all-day wear, from the first ignition to the last mile.

Built for durability, flexibility, and uncompromising protection, the Gale Jacket is the dependable companion for riders who move between terrains, seasons, and challenges with confidence. Wherever your journey takes you, this jacket is made to go the distance.

products.title: REGAL Jacket
products.body_html:
The Xavia Regal Jacket is engineered for riders who demand uncompromising protection, refined functionality, and all-weather versatility — without sacrificing style. Designed with precision and purpose, it combines advanced safety features with technical performance to meet the highest expectations on and off the road.

 

At the core of its protective design is a complete set of CE Level 2 certified protectors at the shoulders, elbows, and back, delivering superior impact resistance in line with professional standards. Reinforced yet unobtrusive, these protectors allow for confident, focused riding across varied conditions and environments.

 

The Regal’s adaptability makes it a true all-season companion. A fully waterproof outer shell shields against rain without the need for additional covers, while removable inner layers — a thermal liner and a waterproof membrane — allow for precise climate control. In warmer conditions, a front zip extension reveals a hidden ventilation panel, complemented by strategically placed vents on the chest, arms, and back for optimized airflow and sustained comfort during long rides.

 

Built for functionality as much as form, the Regal Jacket features waterproof external pockets to safeguard essentials, along with robust YKK zippers for long-lasting performance. A tailored cut, ergonomic design, and integration points for connection to riding trousers enhance both comfort and protection, adapting seamlessly to a rider’s posture and movement.

 

Combining high-end materials, intelligent ventilation, and a sleek, structured silhouette, the Xavia Regal Jacket delivers exceptional performance for discerning riders. Whether navigating urban routes or touring across variable terrain, it ensures you remain protected, comfortable, and ready for whatever the journey brings.

products.title: VENTRA Jacket
products.body_html:
The Xavia Ventra Jacket is built for long-distance riders who demand versatile protection, reliable comfort, and dependable performance across changing conditions. Engineered with precision, it offers a refined touring experience through all seasons, without compromising on safety or practicality.

Designed as a true 3-layer system, the Ventra features a waterproof outer shell, a removable thermal liner, and a removable waterproof membrane — giving you full control over insulation and breathability depending on the weather. The main outer layer is inherently waterproof, providing immediate protection from rain and wind without the need for additional gear.

CE-certified Level 2 protectors are integrated at the shoulders, elbows, and back, delivering premium impact protection while maintaining flexibility and comfort for long days in the saddle. The jacket also includes trouser connectors for added lower-body security — an essential feature for extended touring or higher-speed riding.

Ventilation is engineered for maximum effectiveness. Zippered intake vents on the chest, arms, and back promote consistent airflow, while a discreet front zip extension reveals an additional ventilation panel along the main closure. This intelligent airflow system ensures that heat and moisture are efficiently managed, even in warmer climates or during intensive riding.

Functionality is at the forefront of the Ventra’s design. Waterproof external pockets offer secure storage for essentials, while ergonomic shaping and adjustable fit points at the biceps, waist, and cuffs ensure personalized comfort. Reinforced stitching and durable YKK zippers round out a construction that’s built to last.

Whether you're navigating mountain passes, cruising highways, or riding through unpredictable weather, the Xavia Ventra Jacket is your ideal companion. With a focus on adaptability, rider-focused features, and sleek touring aesthetics, it delivers performance you can trust — mile after mile.

products.title: MISANO Jacket
products.body_html:
The Misano Jacket from Xavia Racing blends vintage character with modern protection in a piece that’s built to ride. Crafted from high-quality soft cowhide leather, this jacket is a tribute to classic motorcycling heritage — but under its timeless styling lies a serious technical structure. Designed for riders who want old-school looks without sacrificing modern safety, the Misano is equipped with CE Level 2 certified protectors on the back, shoulders, and elbows. Reinforced multilayer leather with vertical stitching enhances impact zones, adding structural integrity exactly where it matters most.

Comfort meets craftsmanship in every detail. Ventilated leather panels are seamlessly integrated across the jacket to ensure airflow during warmer rides, maintaining a comfortable internal temperature without disrupting the jacket’s elegant lines. Inside, a fixed mesh lining adds breathability, while a removable thermal liner allows the Misano to shift easily between seasons — giving you the flexibility to ride through both summer heat and cooler conditions with confidence.

Functionality is built into the fit. Elastic leather inserts are placed strategically to encourage natural arm movement and reduce resistance, especially in an aggressive riding posture. The collar is lined with an exceptionally soft-touch material, adding comfort in high-contact areas, while adjustable waist straps and a customizable collar closure allow for a tailored silhouette without compromising mobility.

Storage is minimal and purposeful. Two exterior pockets at the front offer easy access to essentials, supported by multiple interior compartments that keep your valuables organized and secure. Vintage-style YKK zippers reinforce the jacket’s timeless character, while a connection loop and traditional zipper provide integration with compatible riding trousers — making the Misano a complete and road-ready piece.

With its balanced fusion of heritage styling, protective features, and thoughtful ergonomic design, the Misano Leather Jacket is a standout piece for riders who value authenticity without giving up performance. Whether you’re commuting through the city or carving weekend backroads, it brings classic confidence to every ride.

products.title: EVO Gloves
products.body_html:
Design And Material

The Xavia Evo Unisex gloves have been designed to offer a comfortable opening for your hands. Known for their perfect fit and exceptional comfort, the Xavia Evo motorcycle gloves are made with a ventilated and abrasion resistant leather outer shell. Which makes it perfect for urban use in the city. Lightweight and suitable for summer motorcycle trips.

Protection

  • Leather outer shell knuckle protector
  • Padded with a special material and two layers of leather in the areas of greatest impact

Breathable leather

The Evo gloves incorporate hard knuckle protection in a fully ventilated, abrasion resistant leather outer shell

Silicone handle

Silicone grip on the palm, allowing you to better hold on to the handlebar

Touch Screen Compatible

Xavia smart touch technology on thumb and forefinger, so you never have to take off your gloves again to answer your phone or navigation system

Adjustable cuffs

Zippered/hook and loop wrist opening for improved fit and ease of entry and breathable polyester lining to protect hands from moisture

products.title: RISER Gloves
products.body_html:
Design And Material

The design of the Xavia Riser Unisex motorcycle gloves was inspired by the Riser jacket. Known for a very unique pattern on the cuffs, a perfect fit and exceptional comfort, the Xavia Riser motorcycle gloves are made with a ventilated and abrasion resistant leather outer shell. It is constructed with corrugated leather stretch panels on the fingers and wrist that aid in hand movement while riding. The Riser Gloves can be worn over jacket cuffs and is suitable for short and long trips.

Protection

  • Leather outer shell knuckle protector
  • Padded with a special material and two layers of leather in the areas of greatest impact

Breathable leather and stretch panels

The Riser Gloves incorporate hard knuckle protection in a fully ventilated, abrasion resistant leather outer shell and is constructed with ripple leather stretch panels on the wrist and fingers that aid in hand movement.

Silicone handle

Silicone grip on the palm, allowing you to better hold on to the handlebar.

Touch Screen Compatible

Xavia smart touch technology on thumb and forefinger, so you never have to take off your gloves again to answer your phone or navigation system.

Adjustable cuffs

Velcro adjustable cuffs for a better fit, ease of entry and breathable polyester lining to protect hands from moisture.
